description: List workflows. scope "mine" lists the workflows in the API key's workspace (personal, or the team the key's project belongs to). scope "public" searches the public gallery of ready-made workflows, for example every workflow that uses a given model. Use the returned `fullSlug` with get_workflow, run_workflow, clone_workflow or update_workflow. A row marked "graph hidden" is protected: it can still be run, and a clone of it keeps its steps hidden, so only the clone's title, description and tags can change.

model.description: Public gallery only: workflows that use this model, as "owner/model".

only_favorites.description: Public gallery only: workflows you liked.

scope.description: "mine" for your workspace, "public" for the public gallery.

search.description: Text to look for in the title, description or tags.

sort.description: scope "mine": updatetime (default), createtime or title. scope "public": createtime (default), runcount, likecount, clonecount or ratingscore.

tags.description: Public gallery only: workflows with any of these tags.

visibility.description: scope "mine" only: only private or only published workflows.

name: list_workflows

runCount.description: Runs while the workflow was in the public gallery, by anyone. Left out when there are none; the owner's runs of a private workflow are in list_workflow_runs.

title: List Wiro workflows
